name: GNG Electronics Limited
summary: GNG Electronics Limited refurbishes, repairs, and sells laptops and desktops through its Electronics Bazaar brand in India and internationally. The company offers tablets, servers, premium smartphones, mobile workstations, and accessories. It also provides Information Technology Asset Disposition (ITAD) and e-waste management, doorstep service, and financing services; openbox, brand-new, and customised devices; value-added services, such as replacement warranty, on-site installation, upgrades, and buyback programmes; and workstations and other information and communication technology (ICT) devices.
